text: You came a long way to the edge of the chart, {player}.
Sit. The fire's warm and the view goes on forever.
Few sail this far. Fewer sail back the same as they came.
The gate is open. The tide is waiting. So am I.
Warden. The gate sleeps, and the sea is quieter for it.
Sovereign. The sea moves when you walk past it.
Lantern-Bearer. The Court's lights burn on the gate every night.
The stars out here are older than the sea.
Even storms seem small at the end of the world.

options.label: Give it to the Lantern Court. (Permanent)
Tell me about the First Tide.

text: They lived on the Keys when the Keys were mountains. They built the gate to speak to the tide, and the tide answered.
Then it kept answering. The sea rose. The First Tide drowned, and their king with them.
A traveller. Someone who has watched this horizon longer than they'd like to say.
My name went down with my ship a long time ago. 'Wayfarer' will do.
